name: threejs-lab
description: Codex skills and hooks for building production-grade Three.js models, learning labs, physics simulations, and visual QA.

interface.longDescription: Creator workflow for 3D science and learning labs: Three.js scene architecture, procedural and GLB model design, calibrated physics/simulation, performance budgets, visual QA, and installable Codex skill mechanics.
defaultPrompt: Use $learning-lab-3d-creator to build a complete 3D physics lab.
Use $science-model-director and $threejs-design-director before implementation to check science logic and 3D morphology.
Use $threejs-art-director before visual acceptance to block toy-like visuals and weak reference likeness.
Use $visual-lab-qa-agent to create a visual reference first, record a prompt/reference/screenshot/fix ledger, compare benchmark screenshots after, and loop on FIX_REQUIRED.
Use $khtn8-biology-lab-creator to build a strict KHTN8 biology lab with dense detail and FE benchmarks.
Use $threejs-model-creator to create a polished model asset.
Use $learning-lab-qa-pm-reviewer to review this lab before shipping.
